messages:
Olivia: Thinking out loud — proposal to add a small 'deploy kit' to the bot: presets + one-click snapshotting + release-note snippet generation. Goal: reduce ad-hoc rollout steps and make rollbacks trivial. Thoughts?
Samir: love it. Could we also auto-insert a pinned version id and snapshot id into the release note? would make `!rollback` easier.
deploy-bot: new feature idea logged: #FEAT-497 — deploy-presets + snapshotting. Will accept command schema and do basic validation.
Kai: +1. Suggested command surface: `!deploy --preset=web-canary --snapshot --change-window=2026-04-02T22:00Z --notes-template=basic`
Kai: quick preflight suggestion: run `!preflight <preset>` that returns checks (env, LB health, infra quotas, model pin compatibility).
Marie: change windows — we should default to UTC and add a `--soft-window` flag that only gates non-critical changes. Also include a small canary step config, e.g., `canary: 5%, 30m`.
Jamal: rollback ergonomics: store snapshot metadata in the release note and in a small S3/kv path: `s3://redwood-deploy-snapshots/{release_ts}.json`. Then `!rollback --by-snapshot {id}` can reconstruct. Also logging: include `snapshot_id` and `model_pin` in the same object.
Olivia: example release-note snippet I'll add to the template: 

```
Release: web-service v2.14.1
Snapshot: snapshot-20260402-1855012345
Model pin: llm-redwood-14b@v2026-04-01
Canary: 5% for 30m, then 25% for 15m
Notes: feature flag X enabled for rollout
Rollback: `!rollback --snapshot snapshot-20260402-1855012345`
```

Samir: nice. For the presets, we should allow parameter overrides, e.g., `!deploy --preset=fast-commit --set=batch=32 --set=quantize=q4_0` so infra leads can tune without editing presets.
Kai: + small UX ask — add `!deploy --dry-run` output that shows the resulting plan and exact commands the bot will execute. Keep it deterministic.
Marie: ops question — who owns presets? needs a tiny PR review process and a `presets/` dir in repo + a `presets@approved` tag. Also add an audit log in the console.
Olivia: plan: I'll draft the minimal feature PR (bot command parser + snapshot writer + template engine) and a tiny `presets/` markdown with examples. Looking for a volunteer to prototype the `--dry-run` output and the preflight checks.
Samir: I'll take the `--dry-run` + release-note insertion. Can we aim for a short RFC by EOW and a prototype next week?
Jamal: I'll sketch the snapshot schema and the S3 layout. Also will add a tiny script for `snapshot-checksum` to validate integrity.
Olivia: awesome — I'll create the RFC doc and drop a short checklist template in the PR. Thanks all. :rocket:
